content.text: PGA TOUR2026 RBC Heritage prize money payouts for each PGA Tour player Cameron JourdanGolfweekApril 19, 2026Updated April 20, 2026, 8:54 a.m. ETMatt Fitzpatrick picked up his second win of 2026 on Sunday, taking the RBC Heritage in a playoff over world No. 1 Scottie Scheffler.Fitzpatrick also won the Heritage in 2023 via a playoff. His second win at the event, however, comes with a big jump in prize money from his first.He takes home the $3.6 million first-place prize from the $20 million purse.
